Content inside <noscript> only renders with scripting disabled and must not appear in the output

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>visible</p><noscript><p>secret noscript text</p></noscript><p>also visible</p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
